$schema: OnsitePro Test Mode Enforcement Design v1.0
description: Backend-enforced environment segregation design. Three modes: DEMO, TEST, LIVE. UI cannot determine mode — backend enforces all boundaries.
criticalRule: UI cannot determine mode. Backend must enforce.

DEMO.description: Visual-only simulation. No writes to any data store.
DEMO.uiIndicator: Prominent 'DEMO MODE' watermark visible on all screens
DEMO.backendBehavior: Refuses all write operations. Returns mock success responses for UI display only.
DEMO.dataIsolation: No interaction with real data (test or production)

TEST.description: Full functionality, isolated to test sites only. All queries filtered.
TEST.uiIndicator: 'TEST MODE' banner visible. Test sites clearly labeled.
TEST.backendBehavior: All queries include WHERE site.isTestSite=true. Writes validated against site.isTestSite flag.

LIVE.description: Production mode. All operations against real data. Zero tolerance for drift.
LIVE.writePermission: Only to sites where isTestSite=false (or null)
LIVE.backendBehavior: All queries exclude test sites. Full audit logging. All operations auditable.

validateSiteMode.description: Core validation function called by all write operations before execution.
validateSiteMode.signature: validateSiteMode(siteId: UUID, expectedMode: 'test' | 'live') → { valid: boolean, error?: string }
logic: 2. If site not found → return { valid: false, error: 'SITE_NOT_FOUND' }
3. If expectedMode='test' AND site.isTestSite=true → return { valid: true }
4. If expectedMode='live' AND (site.isTestSite=false OR site.isTestSite=null) → return { valid: true }
validateSiteMode.calledBy: Every backend function that writes data (createDailyReport, createSnag, uploadEvidence, etc.)
validateSiteMode.failureBehavior: Return HTTP 403 with error code 'SITE_MODE_MISMATCH'. Log violation to AuditLog.

queryFiltering.description: All read queries must filter by site mode to prevent cross-contamination.

rules.applies: All queries that return site-scoped data

rules.filter: WHERE (site.isTestSite = false OR site.isTestSite IS NULL)
rules.applies: All queries that return site-scoped data

writeProtection.description: Write operations validated against site mode before execution.

protectedOperations.validation: Each action in batch validated individually
protectedOperations.onFailure: Individual action fails; batch continues for other valid actions

demoModeProtection.description: DEMO mode has the strictest protection — zero writes allowed.
implementation: All backend functions check session context for demo flag
If demo=true → return mock success response without executing
Mock responses match real response format for UI compatibility
No audit log entries created (nothing happened)

sessionModeDetection.description: How the system determines which mode a user session is operating in.

approach.primary: Session context includes mode flag set at authentication/app-launch

options.option: User explicitly selects mode at login

options.pros: No extra step; site.isTestSite determines behavior automatically
options.cons: User might not realize they're in test mode
mitigations: Test sites clearly labeled in UI: '[TEST] Site Name'
Banner shown when viewing test site data
All reports/exports from test sites watermarked

approach.selectedApproach: Mode inferred from site selection. Backend enforces via site.isTestSite flag. No separate login or app instance needed.

siteModeLockdown.description: Once a site has operational data, its isTestSite flag cannot be changed.
rules: Site can be created as test (isTestSite=true) or live (isTestSite=false)
isTestSite can be changed ONLY if the site has zero: DailyReports, Snags, Evidence, ChecklistSubmissions, TomorrowPlans
Once any operational data exists, isTestSite is permanently locked
This prevents accidental promotion of test data to production or vice versa

violationLogging.description: All mode violation attempts are logged for security audit.

fields.actualMode: What mode the site is in

alerting.phase2plus: Consider admin notifications for repeated violations

testDataManagement.description: Guidelines for managing test site data.
rules: Test sites should be clearly named (e.g., '[TEST] Sample Construction Site')
Test data can be created freely without affecting production
Test data can be bulk-deleted by admin (unlike production data)
Test data exports are always watermarked
Test data never appears in production reports or dashboards

resetCapability.description: Admin can reset all data for a test site (for re-testing)
resetCapability.restriction: Only available for sites where isTestSite=true

validationChecklist.description: Tests to verify mode enforcement is working correctly.

tests.test: Create daily report on TEST site in TEST mode
Create daily report on LIVE site in TEST mode
Create daily report on TEST site in LIVE mode
Change isTestSite on site with existing reports
Change isTestSite on site with zero data
